note: Every row is one engine call on a freshly built unit at level 20, so nothing carries over between rows. slot is the legacy five-column row the engine projects the status into: remaining rounds (or remaining actions for a charge status), primary magnitude, secondary magnitude, source skill id, and the active flag. instance is the typed status the same projection is read back from. Damage and healing projections are the identity, so the rows measure the status arithmetic and not the trait layer around it. Neither unit holds an item or a characteristic that moves a stat, so base is exactly what the stat projection starts from and every difference between base and stats is a status. The round-start pass walks bank 0 then bank 1 in ascending id order and only ticks the statuses whose tickPhase is ACTIVE_OWNER_ROUND; that phase is data in battle/statuses.json, and what one tick does is graded here.
